description: Schema for application dataset records. Each record in records/*.json must conform to this schema. Run build.py to merge into applications_dataset.csv.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Job title as listed in the JD

fields.name: job_location
fields.description: Location as stated in the JD header

fields.name: salary_min
fields.description: Minimum salary as integer, null if not stated

fields.name: salary_max
fields.description: Maximum salary as integer, null if not stated

fields.name: salary_currency
fields.description: Currency code (EUR, GBP, USD, etc.), null if not stated

fields.name: jd_authorship
fields.description: Who wrote the JD — inferred from technical specificity, scale numbers, named tools vs generic language

fields.name: greenfield_vs_fix
fields.description: Whether the role is building new or improving existing systems

fields.name: velocity_vs_rigour
fields.description: Whether the role prioritises speed or correctness

fields.name: domain_risk
fields.description: Cost of a data error in this role — P&L, political, user-facing, operational

fields.name: collaboration_width
fields.description: Number of named partner teams or functions

fields.name: data_team_maturity
fields.description: Inferred stage of the data team

fields.name: urgency
fields.description: Whether the JD signals an urgent or backfill hire

fields.name: language_gate_languages
fields.description: Languages named in the gate (empty array if none)

fields.name: interview_stages
fields.description: Number of interview stages if stated in JD, null otherwise

fields.name: role_type
fields.description: Role category for filtering — AE/BI roles are the primary analysis target

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Verbatim quotes from the JD substantiating each Layer B classification

properties.velocity_vs_rigour: Verbatim quote(s) driving the rigour/velocity/mixed classification
properties.domain_risk: Verbatim quote(s) signalling the domain risk level
properties.jd_authorship: Verbatim quote(s) signalling hiring manager vs recruiter authorship
properties.greenfield_vs_fix: Verbatim quote(s) signalling build vs scale/fix mission
properties.data_team_maturity: Verbatim quote(s) signalling team size and stage
properties.collaboration_width: Verbatim quote(s) naming the partner teams
properties.language_gate: Verbatim quote of language requirement, or Not stated in JD
properties.urgency: Verbatim quote(s) signalling urgency, or No urgency signals present

notes: Add new fields here when the schema evolves. build.py will emit null for records that predate the new field.
language_gate_languages is stored as a JSON array in record files; build.py flattens it to comma-separated in the CSV.
boolean_or_null fields use null when the record predates the field being added to the schema.
